notes:
Lead: Head of Product (Maya Patel) is technical and cares about tail latency and conversational context memory. Primary ask: internal IT/helpdesk chatbot to handle 60k messages/month, 30 concurrent agents during peak.

Summary of engagement:
- 2026-01-15: Intro call (Priya) — high-level requirements, runbook shared.
- 2026-01-22: Architecture workshop (SE: Ethan) — discussed streaming + tool-calling (calendar lookup, ticket lookup).
- 2026-02-10: Security questionnaire submitted (attached drive doc).
- 2026-02-18: Demo of hosted API streaming + function calls (fireflies ff_2026-02-18).
- 2026-02-25: Follow-up on KV cache and batching strategy; discussed Dedicated for predictable throughput (fireflies ff_2026-02-25).
- 2026-03-02: Kickoff POC (2-week) for hosted API: 3 prompts, tool integrations (Jira, Okta, internal CMDB).

Requirements / constraints (customer):
- Latency: 95th <200ms token tail for short assistant responses; warm start streaming important.
- Throughput: support 25-40 RPS during support spikes; autoscaling needs predictable behavior.
- Function/tool calling: secure webhook signing + per-request role context.
- Auditing: immutable audit logs for all agent interactions, retention configurable to 12 months.
- Data residency: primary in us-east; possible EU shard for EU customer subset.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget, wants hosted to prove value then move to Dedicated reserved capacity if $$$/token favorable.

Notes from last call (2026-03-02):
- "We care more about latency & traceability than lowest token cost right now." — Maya Patel.
- Security asked: need SOC2 + SAML, KMS integration and proof of audit log immutability.
- SE action: provide sample token-level latency breakdown, streaming rate limits, and an estimated monthly price for hosted POC with audit logging enabled.

POC success criteria (agreed):
- 95th percentile response latency <200ms for <50 token responses under 30 concurrent sessions.
- Function calls (ticket lookup) complete end-to-end <350ms.
- Audit logs captured in customer-provided S3 bucket and verified (sample query).
- No regression on NLU intent detection vs baseline (precision >90% on test set).

Next steps (short):
- SE to provide latency telemetry sample and hosted POC price (Priya) — due 2026-03-07.
- Security will validate audit log flow to S3; customer to run ingestion test week of 2026-03-08.
- Pricing: plan draft for Dedicated if hosted POC shows predictable unit-cost >60 days.

Stated objections / risks:
- If hosted audit/retention add-on doubles cost, CFO will push for Dedicated or self-host.
- Heavy reliance on tool-calling increases security review time (webhook signing, replay protection).
short_description: Mid-market IT/Helpdesk SaaS evaluating Redwood hosted API (streaming + tool-calls) with short latency SLOs; will consider Dedicated after POC if unit economics favorable.
